text:
maria: quick heads-up — discovered another stream leak when canceling mid-chunk during a token rotate. sockets stick around.

kevin: repro? sample app?

maria: small one. start sample, call /sse twice, then force auth refresh by expiring test token. cancel client while chunk inflight.

maria: minimal: ```py
async with Client(api_key=KEY) as c:
    async for part in c.stream('completion', prompt):
        if stop_after_first:
            break
```

maria: after break process still shows 2 extra TCP sockets. trace points to StreamIterator.__anext__ leaving an awaitable running that never gets cancelled when connector swapped.

olga: could be same root cause as earlier generator-finalizer races, but slightly different because this is chunked SSE framing. finalizer doesn't call aclose if transport already detached.

alex: small API idea: provide a helper context manager `client.stream_ctx(...)` that yields an async iterator and guarantees cleanup in __aexit__. keeps user code simple.

sam: please also add typing: export a `StreamIterator` Protocol in stubs and annotate stream() -> AsyncIterator[Union[str, bytes]]. pyright flags currently.

nora: for tests we should simulate a slow chunk and then rotate auth mid-stream. i can add a tiny aiohttp server in tests/streams/test_midchunk_rotate.py. include sock-count asserts.

kevin: implement plan: (1) nora adds integration server, (2) alex prototypes stream_ctx, (3) sam updates stubs, (4) olga and maria verify on staging.

maria: one caution: if __aexit__ awaits aclose and consumer holds the queue, teardown can deadlock. use aclose that cancels internal pump instead of waiting on consumer. add short timeouts in tests.

dev-bot: CI #4200 queued — note: coverage drop in streaming.py by 0.3% (new tests incoming).

kevin: ok moving this to the sprint. i'll create a ticket and link prs. thanks all :raised_hands:

maria: thx — will attach heap/sock dumps when i open PR.

dev-bot: ticket created: INF-842 stream ctx manager + typing fixes
